entity_types.ORGANIZATION: A non-commercial body: government agency, school, court, NGO, team
entity_types.PRODUCT: A named product, model or service offering
entity_types.LOCATION: A place: address, city, state, country, building, site
entity_types.TECHNOLOGY: A technology, platform, language, standard or tool
entity_types.PROJECT: A named project, programme, case or initiative
entity_types.DOCUMENT: A named document, contract, policy, certificate or identifier-bearing record
entity_types.CONCEPT: An abstract idea, topic, role or category that matters in the text
entity_types.EVENT: Something that happened or will happen at a point in time: meeting, incident, transaction

relation_types.WORKS_FOR: Source person is employed by / works for target organization or company
relation_types.WORKS_WITH: Source collaborates or partners with target
relation_types.MANAGES: Source manages, leads or supervises target
relation_types.MEMBER_OF: Source is a member of target group or organization
relation_types.PROVIDES: Source provides or offers target (product, service)
relation_types.PROVIDES_TO: Source provides goods or services to target customer
relation_types.CREATED: Source created, authored or founded target
relation_types.ISSUED_BY: Source document was issued by target
relation_types.ISSUED_TO: Source document was issued to target
relation_types.PARTY_TO: Source is a party to target contract, case or agreement
relation_types.LOCATED_IN: Source is located in target place
relation_types.PART_OF: Source is part of / a subsidiary or component of target
relation_types.RELATED_TO: Any other stated relationship between source and target
